headline: Triage legacy Leantime validation tasks and milestones
description:
Finding

Leantime still contains older validation and governance tasks/milestones that are open, blocked, or pending without a current repository workflow owner.

Targets

  • Tasks 17, 19, 20, 21, 24, 37, 38, 39, 40
  • Milestones 18 and 21 if they are no longer active work containers

Expected Outcome

For each item decide: close as obsolete, keep as active roadmap work, or re-scope into a current tracked workflow.

headline: Decide retention for placeholder boards and empty canvases
description:
Finding

Leantime contains placeholder or low-signal boards that currently add noise.

Targets

  • Ideas board 3: Tablica
  • Retrospective board 4: Tablica
  • Value canvas 14: NextJS Boilerplate Value Canvas (0 items)

Expected Outcome

headline: Repair auth foundation Leantime metadata linkage
description:

headline: Create repository-level task index outside AI task folders
